compileProvenance.compilerVersion:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

limits: Synthetic extrema/texture input, one plane, payload85/raw340, canonical program, range64...940, and two geometries.
Only five warmup pairs plus ten measured pairs per geometry; inclusive quartiles and observed dispersion are reported, without a confidence interval.

Scratch is warm and retained in measured calls; first-call allocation is saved separately in the raw warmups. Input reset, program/reference construction, output comparison and SHA256 hashing are outside timing.
Whole-engine/movie timing, real-media qualification, complete new-app movie completion, Intel execution, and all pixel-format/payload performance are unverified by this capture.
Resampling, motion search, temporal history, measurement, encoding, checkpointing and I/O are outside this spatial-call timer.
The exact cause of observed run-to-run dispersion is unknown; no scheduler/hardware-counter profile was captured.
Process snapshots and the parent-reserved quiet window establish no known build/test overlap, not a trace of every unrelated operating-system process.

observedConclusion.scope: Synthetic single-plane spatial reconstruction stage, complete validated production call on this arm64 host with live Ferris contention.

originalXCTestCaptureAudit.conclusion: The original 8.911173 ratio is supported by its five raw paired samples at 3840x1632. This independent ten-pair actual-prechange comparison measured 7.970710 for that geometry. Both are spatial-stage captures; a constant or whole-movie multiplier is not established.
originalXCTestCaptureAudit.statisticsMethod: Median and inclusive quartiles; sample standard deviation; each paired ratio is serialSeconds[i]/parallelSeconds[i]. No confidence interval is claimed for five pairs.

testSourceAudit.baselineLimitation: XCTest compared serial and parallel policy in the updated module, rather than two separately compiled old/current modules.
testSourceAudit.scopeLimitation: Spatial conditioning stage only; synthetic input; active Ferris contention; no whole-movie speedup claim.

rawCapture.baseline: Exact production source from Git 817f1f2f56f5b59a5d36818505c368e12069bf48, original serial algorithm and API, separately compiled optimized binary.
rawCapture.candidate: Frozen current production source, default .automatic execution, separately compiled optimized binary.
rawCapture.pairOrder: Alternates prechange/candidate and candidate/prechange across warmups and measured pairs; first measured pair is candidate/prechange.
rawCapture.processActivity: Both binaries use identical Foundation userInitiatedAllowingIdleSystemSleep activity for the entire process.
rawCapture.scope: One entire production ASHSpatialReconstructorV4.reconstructInPlace call, with validation, conditioned controls, retained workspace preparation, cancellation check, and serial ring/stencil or parallel halo capture/dispatch/join. Input reset, reference construction, exact full-sample/control comparisons and SHA256 hashing are outside timing.
rawCapture.scratch: Each long-lived binary owns a distinct workspace/output array for the entire geometry; allocation count and identity captured on every invocation; cold first allocation is a warmup and retained-workspace calls are measured.
rawCapture.statisticsMethod: Median, inclusive quartiles, sample standard deviation, median absolute deviation. Paired ratios divide prechangeSeconds by candidateSeconds at the same pair index. No whole-movie claim or statistical confidence interval.
